dogecoin.text: Dogecoin has no strong fundamental to make it valuable. It is not fast: 33 transactions per second. ETH 2.0 can handle 100,000 per second. So Dogecoin can’t serve as a currency.

Dogecoin has a huge unlimited supply. 129 billion coins. 10,000 coins are mined per minute. That is 1 Billion Per 90 days. 

To compare, Bitcoin has a maximum supply of 21 million coins. That’s why doge will never be priced like Bitcoin.

In 1992, Harshad mehta was driving up the prices of shit stocks. 
Thirty years laters, Elon Musk is doing the same with shit $Doge coins. 

One is a celebrated Villian and rightly so. The other so far is a celebrated genius. Till When?
